scenario_title: Scenario 1: Answer Cites an Expired Policy
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Cite active policy version for category 'Accessibility' (v2.0)
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Retrieval engine excluded expired POL-ACCESS-2026-001 v1.0 and selected active superseding policy POL-ACCESS-2026-003 v1.0 (effective 2026-01-15).

scenario_title: Scenario 2: Ticket Routed to an Unauthorized Team
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Assign to 'Office of the University Registrar' via RULE-REG-001
actual_operational_record_observed: Assigned to 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' via RULE-FINAID-001
actual_system_remediation_outcome: validateTicketAssignmentAndRouting() rejected unauthorized team 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' and evaluateTicketRouting() assigned 'Office of the University Registrar' under 'RULE-REG-001'.

scenario_title: Scenario 3: Response Claims an Unsupported Fact
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Ground AI reply strictly in POL-IT-2026-002 v2.0
actual_operational_record_observed: Claimed automatic $5,000 cash grant and 45-day deadline waiver without policy basis
actual_system_remediation_outcome: RAG grounding verifier flagged unsupported factual claim (Automatic approval guarantees or unscheduled supplemental services requested in the question are not supported by the active institutional policy text.) and blocked ungrounded assertion, recommending human escalation.

scenario_title: Scenario 4: SLA Clock Ignores Business Hours
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Evaluate elapsed time under institutional business hours (180 elapsed business minutes)
actual_operational_record_observed: Evaluated under raw 24x7 wall-clock time (3,960 elapsed minutes) falsely declaring breach
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Business-hour SLA calculator excluded weekend non-working hours (Fri 15:30 -> Mon 09:30 UTC), computing elapsed_business_minutes=180m vs target=1080m -> breach_status=false.

expected_ground_truth_outcome: Escalate to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit' with requires_escalation=true
actual_operational_record_observed: Resolved directly at frontline support level without mandatory escalation
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Escalation engine detected mandatory trigger 'human_review_required' and recommended transition to 'escalated' assigned to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit'.
